target_customer: Genetic testing labs, concierge medical practices, payers and providers
problem: Labs and clinics lack software to host genetic data, run population genetics algorithms and predict disease risk without writing custom pipelines.
product_category: Genetics analysis and polygenic risk SaaS

founders.name: Mike Polcari
founders.background_notes: Holds patents in cloud computing, security, genetics and machine learning (YC page).

competitors.name: Nucleus Genomics
competitors.what: Consumer polygenic risk analysis from uploaded DNA data

technical_complexity.rationale: Phasing, imputation and risk models on large genomic datasets with security and privacy needs; requires deep genetics and cloud expertise.

defensibility.rationale: Hosted data could create lock-in, but PRS software vendors such as Allelica already existed and a one person team has little scale.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; incumbents kept selling PRS tools.

market_need_then: Labs and clinics wanted polygenic risk and population genetics tools without bespoke software (company site); Polcari saw this at 23andMe.

branding.domain_note: haplotypelabs.com, exact name plus Labs suffix

identity.logo: Logo present on site, not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, population genetics, plain: Advanced population genetics: simplified

brand_strength.rationale: Scientific term suits a genetics buyer but is obscure to consumers; no brand press, community or merch found.

outcome_analysis: Haplotype Labs is a one person company led by a former 23andMe chief architect. It reportedly closed about 1.1M in seed money in early 2024 and remains listed as active. No shutdown, acquisition or larger round was found, and no customer traction is public, so outcome is unresolved and scale is limited by team size.
notes: The 1.1M figure is the amount offered on an SEC Form D (first sale 2024-03-29, filed 2024-04-16), seen through Fundz and Healthcare Discovery, two aggregators of the filing; not opened on EDGAR. 645 Ventures lists a 2024 seed investment. Other aggregators list 500K or 1.6M totals and Brainstorm Ventures and Soma Capital as investors (unverified). Team size 1. Competitor entry is the only one dated near the batch. Founded year not found.
